# Lamp Builder 1.2.0
- Updated wrench-and-bulb icon in the app, Dock and Home toolbar button. - Save to Library is the primary save action, including Command-S. Collections organize the actual files on your Mac. Export Project Copy is available for sharing or a separate backup. - Opening a project from Home or the library returns to its existing tab. First library saves now associate the tab with the saved file. - Rotate fittings, previews and mounted accessories in 45-degree (one-eighth turn) steps. - Cord-entry placement uses a crosshair over the highlighted fitting. The action is now named Add cord entry. - Socket and bulb choices remain expanded in Properties, with all three illustrated bulb styles preserved. - Add a configurable steel support disk beneath a flange, starting at 24 inches by one-quarter inch. Enter a measured mass or use the labeled steel-density estimate. The disk is visible in 3D and included in center-of-mass and support-footprint calculations. - Balance includes an animated tipping-risk cue, with Reduce Motion support. This is a static planning estimate, not a physical tipping simulation or a weld/anchor strength assessment. - X-ray reveals proposed internal wire routes through the current design. Wiring opens a circuit concept, socket/switch/entry inventory, editable external cord length and end allowances, and estimated internal runs, with PDF export. - Wiring recognizes both separate switches and older toggle-switch caps. Disconnected loads, multiple entries and unresolved switch arrangements are flagged instead of receiving invented circuit assignments.
Balance, routing and sample dimensions are estimates. Wiring output is a concept for review, not a fabrication-approved wiring plan: electrical ratings, grounding, strain relief, conductor fill and testing still require verification. Existing projects, collections and receipts remain in their current locations.
Requires an Apple silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later.
